items.source: Creates a statement that returns all labels of a node that are not part of a list parameter named Constants.NAME_OF_STATIC_LABELS_PARAM.
items.translation: 创建一个语句，返回不属于名为Constants.NAME_OF_STATIC_LABELS_PARAM的列表参数的节点的所有标签。

items.source: Creates a statement that returns all labels of a node that are not part of a list parameter named Constants.NAME_OF_STATIC_LABELS_PARAM. Those are the "dynamic labels" of a node as set through SDN.
items.translation: 创建一个语句，返回不属于名为Constants.NAME_OF_STATIC_LABELS_PARAM的列表参数的节点的所有标签。这些是节点通过 SDN 设置的“动态标签”。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this class. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。该字符串必须与用于在此类中声明枚举常量的标识符完全匹配。（不允许存在多余的空白字符。）

items.source:
A generator based on the schema defined by node and relationship descriptions. Most
methods return renderable Cypher statements.

items.source: This will create a match statement that fits the given node description and may contain additional conditions. The WITH clause of this statement contains all nodes and relationships necessary to map a record to the given nodeDescription.
items.translation: 这将创建一个符合给定节点描述的匹配语句，并可能包含额外的条件。该语句的 `WITH` 子句包含了所有用于将记录映射到给定 `nodeDescription` 所需的节点和关系。
